vetSays.line: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a red moon rising between the trees, breathing: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Teresa, Arturo, Adrián and Miguel met them at the door — 4 put down. Teresa, Arturo, Adrián, Miguel are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Callback: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (At the fire, Farid told Lorenzo, Teresa, Arturo, and 3 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adrián just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (At the fire, Adaeze told Lorenzo, Arturo, Jessica, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
🛡️ Jessica, Adrián and Ursula met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jessica, Adrián, Ursula are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Moderator: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound gets un-written.) (At the fire, Karen told Adaeze, Adrián, Miguel, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Focus Group: Be boring — bore them out of the room. The murmur loves violence one round and is bored by it the next. Be deliberately boring for three rounds — recite bus schedules, count ceiling tiles — and they lose interest and LEAVE. (Striking is entertainment; every swing is a review.) (Arturo lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Arturo told Teresa and Lena how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Landlord: Never end on leased ground. Rent comes due every round you end on leased ground — keep moving and the ledger starves. Each ADDENDUM raises the rent and heals it. Never end two rounds on the same dirt. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Karen just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Bulldozer: Step OFF the lane. When it lowers its head, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back. It can't turn and it never goes around. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Union Rep: Kill the rep first. It does not fight, it ORGANIZES — kill the rep before WALKOUT or the stomp lands as one. First blood on the rep, every time. Every ally it rallies hits +3 harder. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Arturo, Karen, Miguel, Ursula and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Arturo, Karen, Miguel, Ursula, Nino are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish. Every uninterrupted turn is a loaded bite. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Loud-Eyes: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Arturo just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Herald: Read the omens — reposition freely. It announces everything — read the omens. It is slow: reposition freely, never trade blows standing still. (It is a tutorial — the real test comes later. Learn it here, cheap.) (Yoshiko lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Yoshiko told Karen and Adrián how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Eater: Poison the meal. It cannot tell good food from bad — it gorges, it does not chew, and it eats the grid first, you second. Feed it spoiled or diseased meat and watch it vomit out the fight. (Or starve the field: burn your own crops and deny it fuel. Guard the pantry — always.) (At the fire, Yoshiko told Nino, Karen, Adrián, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Ugly: Contradict the narration. It is a STORY and stories need listeners — it narrates you faltering, and the verses count down. Contradict it with your actions: it says you run, you advance. Three true contradictions and the story dismisses you kindly. (It says you falter — do not.) (At the fire, David told Farid, Ursula and Cormac how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Lose on purpose — tank the prediction. It is about the NEXT action, not your history — the predictable get countered. Lose on purpose: stand there and take the soft prediction for two rounds and its model goes mushy. (The most engaging thing is an upset; be the upset.) (Cormac lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Cormac told Ursula and David how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (At the fire, Yoshiko told Karen, Ursula, David, and 1 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cormac just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Big Beast: Do something you have never done. It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. Do something you have never done and it has nothing to wear. Novelty is literally the weapon; repetition is the uniform it dresses you in. (At the fire, Yoshiko told Ursula, Adrián and Lena how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
